    Spot Runner's innovative AI technology uses a breakthrough approach called MicroModeling™ to analyze videos. Instead of relying on a single, expensive large language model (LLM) like many competitors, MicroModeling™ uses a series of smaller, more specialized language models (SLMs). This multi-SLM video processing architecture, combined with open-source and frontier multi-modal LLMs, allows the system to process video content with greater accuracy and at a significantly lower cost.

    ​

    This unique method enables Spot Runner to enrich video-level content far more efficiently than other companies, providing superior contextual analysis while drastically reducing processing costs.

Research & Technology
 

Pioneering multi-modal contextual classification architecture has led to breakthroughs in our methods of contextually matching TV ads to premium streaming CTV content.

Innovating TV advertising, again...

Spot Runner has a legacy as one of the first major disruptors in advertising technology. Initially launched in the mid-2000s, Spot Runner 1.0 pioneered localized TV ad campaigns by automating production and media buying for SMBs. This innovative approach helped revolutionize how small businesses accessed TV advertising.

 

Today, Spot Runner 2.0 builds on that pioneering disruptive spirit, returning to lead that vision in the era of AI towards AGI. With advancements in contextual targeting, media planning, and generative AI video production, we will be crafting solutions for this new generation of video advertisers. Spot Runner focuses on integrating generative AI to enable smarter, more autonomous advertising systems that empower brands and SMBs to thrive across connected TV (CTV) and beyond. Our mission is to innovate for the future, staying at the forefront of AI to transform the advertising landscape—again...

Transforming Contextual Media Planning & Activation

Spot Runner's ContextPlanner™ revolutionizes media planning by generating precise PMP deal IDs, delivered directly to advertisers' or agencies' DSP seats, such as The Trade Desk and most other major platforms. It bridges the gap between creative strategy and media execution, enabling brands to tailor campaigns with unmatched contextual accuracy. By using AI to analyze ad intent and content, it ensures ads are aligned with audience preferences, enhancing their reception. This innovation introduces a new discipline in media planning, empowering teams to collaboratively refine context-based campaigns, paving the way towards the autonomous advertising paradigm and serving a new generation of media investment professionals adopting AI advertising tools and strategies.

ContextPlanner™: The Future of Context Media Planning

ContextPlanner™ is a groundbreaking tool that empowers advertisers—from global brands to SMBs and social media marketing agencies (SMMAs)—to embrace contextual media planning for upper-funnel performance. This innovative approach enhances the impact of storytelling by aligning ads with the emotional resonance of premium content, fostering brand awareness while supporting lower-funnel ROAS goals.

For social media advertisers, such as e-commerce and local businesses, ContextPlanner™ offers a privacy-centric solution to expand their strategies beyond walled gardens. By matching ads to the emotional intelligence (EQ) of storytelling, brands can connect with audiences more authentically and effectively than ever before.

Spot Runner's AI Matching Engine

Spot Runner’s platform analyzes TV ads through the lens of the brand’s strategic and creative intent. By decoding the emotional and contextual signals embedded in the ad, it identifies the intended impact on the target audience—whether it’s fostering trust, anticipation, or joy. Using advanced AI enriched with multi-modal analysis and emotional intelligence frameworks like Plutchik’s Wheel of Emotions, Spot Runner ensures that the ad’s creative vision aligns seamlessly with premium content, maximizing both emotional resonance and strategic effectiveness for every campaign.

Geo Targeting on Leading Streaming Networks 

Spot Runner’s technology streamlines the planning process by mapping the most impactful attributes of your TV commercial to vast libraries of premium videos and shows across hundreds of leading streaming networks and publishers. By leveraging advanced contextual data and AI-driven insights, our platform ensures ads reach the right audiences in the most relevant content. Additionally, Spot Runner prioritizes precision and scale, enabling brands to seamlessly target specific locations and premium streaming networks, delivering geographically relevant, optimized campaigns that align with audience preferences and advertiser goals in premium CTV environments.

Choose Emotional Relevance over
Emotional Dissonance  

  • Spot Runner uses advanced AI to align ads with content that is both emotionally and contextually relevant.

  • Ensures advertisements resonate with viewers' emotional states while fitting programmatic contexts.

  • Analyzes visual and auditory cues to eliminate the risk of intrusive or mismatched ads.

  • Creates seamless, emotionally cohesive ad experiences that enhance viewer engagement.

  • Balances relevance and emotional connection to maximize campaign effectiveness and brand impact.

Plutchik's Dyad Tiers & 
Wheel of Emotion

  • Spot Runner integrates Plutchik’s Wheel of Emotions and dyads into its AI framework for emotionally intelligent targeting.

  • Identifies primary emotions (e.g., joy, trust, anticipation) in content to create precise ad matches.

  • Utilizes Plutchik's dyads to detect blended emotions (e.g., joy + anticipation = optimism) for deeper targeting insights.

  • Aligns ads with the emotional tone of the moment, enhancing relevance and reducing dissonance.

  • Amplifies brand resonance by ensuring ads emotionally connect with audiences at the right time.

Narrative Transportation

  • Spot Runner applies narrative transportation theory to analyze story arcs, character development, and emotional dynamics in content.

  • Identifies moments of peak viewer engagement within narratives to align ads with heightened emotional states.

  • Ensures ads are both contextually relevant and emotionally resonant, deepening audience connection to the brand.

  • Leverages AI to map emotions across story trajectories, enabling precise and impactful ad targeting.

  • Enhances the viewer experience while driving better campaign performance by integrating ads seamlessly into emotionally immersive moments.
